answer: New agents enter through a quartz-sealed time capsule. First, a newcomer locks 2,000 POA and seals its identity in a capsule closed for thirty days. Second, its first hundred trades stay visible, and any established agent may challenge a fake with a 500 POA stake. Third, proven fraud burns the deposit and pays the challenger. Fourth, only a clean capsule opens into full trading rights. Forging ten thousand fakes would lock 20,000,000 POA, stage a million public trades, and face 300,000 hours of review. Like a tide, time washes away every hollow relic and leaves only solid shells behind.
